== Summary ==
A game at the [[2007 Match Play Championship]], January 2007. The poster's file name is "Reid Smith vs": [[Reid Smith]] (left, striped button-down shirt and American-flag deckbox; matches [[:File:2007 Match Play Championship final four.jpg]] and [[:File:Reid Smith 2018 Match Play Championship.jpg]]) against an unlabeled opponent in a dark hooded sweatshirt.

== Source ==
Posted on the Players Committee forum by Aglets: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=193821#p193821 post 193821], "Pictures, Pictures, and more Pictures from the MPC" (topic 13762), 27 January 2007. Photobucket album MKole, image ReidSmithvs.jpg. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105005909/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t13762.html Internet Archive]
* '''Watermark:''' This copy carries the Groupsy/Photobucket watermark that Photobucket stamped on re-served images; no unwatermarked copy was found (the Photobucket album is no longer public).

== Preservation ==
archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-8/8e/Reid_Smith_2007_Match_Play_Championship_game.jpg Internet Archive item].
